tools_helpful.evidence: Agent read injected TODO[migrate-NNN] + Triage labels and MIGRATION-MAPPING.md to drive the port; final app scored 100 (3/3 features pass).

tools_problematic.problem: Anchor lookup fails hard with no recovery hint. The two anchors the agent guessed for the manifest section ('manifest-migration-checklist', 'manifest') both returned only "Anchor '#X' not found" with no list of valid anchors, so the agent abandoned the tool entirely and never fetched any pattern.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turns 16-18 (lines 1914-1943): both -Anchor calls Write-Error not-found; agent then grep'd '## ' headings and hand-wrote the manifest changes.

tool_limitations.limitation: Resolves only exact explicit <a id="..."> anchors; a near-miss guess yields no candidate list and no substring match, so the agent cannot self-correct in one turn.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: On not-found, enumerate the available <a id> anchors and attempt a unique substring match before failing.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md line 158 link to the Manifest migration checklist
doc_errors.wrong: Links to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#manifest-migration-checklist-windowsdesktop--runfulltrust (a markdown-slug of the ### heading), but Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 only resolves explicit <a id="..."> anchors and no such anchor exists — so the documented fetch mechanism cannot retrieve the manifest section.
doc_errors.correct: The manifest checklist needs an explicit anchor and SKILL.md should point at #manifest so `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest` works.

special_apis.special_handling: Ported as-is; APIs exist in Windows App SDK. GeneratorOperationArea kept Visibility=Collapsed until a generator instantiates (matches UWP) — no special migration handling required.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The Manifest migration checklist section has no explicit <a id> anchor; Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 keys off <a id> anchors, and SKILL.md advertises a slug link the tool cannot consume.
errors_encountered.fix: Add above the heading and correct the SKILL.md link; harden the script to list valid anchors on a miss.

errors_encountered.error: Nullable-reference warnings (CS8600/CS8601/CS8602/CS8618) across ported .xaml.cs and SampleConfiguration.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: SDK-sample code assigns rootPage/generator/Title outside the constructor; scaffold enables nullable. Warnings only, build succeeded.
errors_encountered.fix: None required for score; benign warnings.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two consecutive Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 calls failed with 'Anchor not found'; agent gave up on the helper and grep'd headings instead, never retrieving the manifest checklist content.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 2 failed tool calls + 1 grep fallback (~3 turns)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manifest section lacks an <a id> anchor and SKILL.md links to a non-resolvable slug; the not-found error gives no valid-anchor list to recover from.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent grep'd '## ' headings and hand-authored the manifest edits (this app had no background-task extension, so it still launched).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add <a id="manifest"> anchor + fix SKILL.md link; make Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 print available anchors (and try a unique substring match) on a miss.

env_issues.issue: WinUI 3 screenshots captured blank (composition/PrintWindow artifact) and UWP CoreWindow not drivable via UIA — both on the scoring side only.
env_issues.workaround: Scorer verified via UIA inspect; not a migration-skill concern (eval instrument limitation).
